reviewer_item: NHSJS Must Fix 3: adding a second ManiSkill3 task
question: Within each provenance-clean saved RDT-170M m=128 PegInsertionSide and PickSingleYCB curve, how much does changing only the response from Q to stabilized N change saved-grid normalized AUC?
pre_outcome_knowledge: Before this protocol, only file structure was read: record counts, duplicate keys, own-sidecar fingerprints, success labels and calls per episode (notes Month 9/9.2 section 4). No paired difference was computed on these files.

anchors.run_machinery: analysis.paired_rescoring.oneb_success authenticate and compute, applied to this protocol

runs.known_duplicates: A --resume restart replayed episode 1: the 219 physical faithfulness rows and the 227 physical step-file lines (219 step rows and 8 episode_end rows) each hold 19 repeated keys, all in episode 1. The last physical occurrence of each key is selected (analysis.revision.core.reconcile); the classification and differing fields of every duplicate group are reported.
runs.documented_language_input: Month 4 m=128 run (E2 IG and E5 faithfulness, faithfulness file dated 2026-05-29): the RDT authors' precomputed PegInsertionSide instruction embedding and a zeroed BOS/EOS placeholder baseline (notes Month 4/4.6)

Month 7 verification rerun of the m=128 seed-42 arm (V4, 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-25): T5-XXL instruction embeddings generated with encode_task_lang.py and the encoded two-token baseline (notes Month 7/7.2)

Month 4 m=128 run (faithfulness file dated 2026-05-29): PickSingleYCB is absent from the RDT authors' precomputed embeddings, so the PickCube instruction embedding was used as a proxy, with a zeroed BOS/EOS placeholder baseline (notes Month 4/4.3, 4.6)

Month 7 verification rerun of the m=128 seed-42 arm (V4, 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-25): T5-XXL instruction embeddings generated with encode_task_lang.py and the encoded two-token baseline (notes Month 7/7.2)

excluded.reason: Pre-fix seed-42 m=128 faithfulness run that loaded seed-142 sidecars under shared sidecar filenames; own-sidecar fingerprint 0% (notes Month 7/7.1, Month 9/9.2). Excluded by exact filename; a pattern such as metrics_faithfulness_metrics_*_seed42_m128_* must never be used to select inputs.

Pre-fix seed-42 m=128 faithfulness run that loaded seed-142 sidecars under shared sidecar filenames; own-sidecar fingerprint 0% (notes Month 7/7.1, Month 9/9.2). Excluded by exact filename; a pattern such as metrics_faithfulness_metrics_*_seed42_m128_* must never be used to select inputs.

exclusion_documentation: For each excluded file: the own-sidecar fingerprint against its nominal step file (must be 0 agreeing rows in both modalities, otherwise the analysis fails), and the general-form fingerprint against the clean seed-142 step file of the same task joined on (task, model, episode, policy_call_idx) without the seed label (recorded, no expectation). Excluded files are never rescored.
native_scale_rule: Saved curves are Q-scored (default logpi target), Q = -r/(2*512); r = -2*512*Q. Every stored vision and language f_input must equal 0, otherwise the run fails.
occurrence_rule: last physical occurrence of each key within its source file (analysis.revision.core.reconcile); the conflict-excluded membership comparison is recorded
own_sidecar_fingerprint: Join each faithfulness row to its run's step row on (task, model, seed, episode, policy_call_idx). For vision and language, original form: abs(-step_gap - f_baseline) <= 1e-6*max(abs(step_gap), abs(f_baseline), 1e-12); general form: the same test of step_gap against f_input - f_baseline. Every row of every included run must join and agree in both forms, otherwise the analysis fails.
success_label: The boolean success field of the run's own episode_end row joined on (task, model, seed, episode); every included episode is a failure (expected_roster successes 0), so there is no success split.
rescoring: analysis.paired_rescoring.analyze.paired_curve(k_grid_auc, curve, f_input, f_baseline, 'Q', dimension=512, epsilon=1e-12) per saved curve; Delta = AUC_Q - AUC_N on the same saved nodes and endpoints; positive Delta means scoring with N lowers that AUC.
language_policy: Language is summarized per run only and never pooled: the seed-142 runs used the authors' precomputed embedding (for PickSingleYCB, the PickCube embedding as a proxy) with a zeroed placeholder baseline, while the Month 7 reruns used encode_task_lang.py embeddings with the encoded baseline. Vision uses the gray-image baseline in every run and is pooled per task.
statistics: identical to analysis/paired_rescoring/oneb_success/protocol.json statistics, with the single outcome group all

bootstrap.rng: numpy.random.default_rng PCG64, integers(0, G, size=(block, G)) in blocks of at most 128 draws, the index stream of analysis.revision.core.bootstrap_summary
bootstrap.unit: whole recorded episode within the summarized population, unstratified by run; all defined calls of a selected episode stay together
bootstrap.median_draw: median of all resampled defined calls with multiplicity
bootstrap.mean_draw: math.fsum mean of the resampled within-episode means
bootstrap.interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles, numpy linear method reproduced in pure Python
bootstrap.status: fewer than 2 episodes gives no interval (insufficient_groups); exactly 2 is two_group_descriptive_only; otherwise conditional_empirical_episode_percentile
bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive conditional intervals over recorded episodes; no multiplicity adjustment, calibration or significance claim

undefined_policy: A zero endpoint gap in either response leaves the paired effect undefined; such calls stay in raw counts and are excluded only from defined-call statistics. Nonfinite or malformed values fail. No clipping, trimming or substitution.

outputs.inputs.json: anchor verification, per-file authentication, stored-arithmetic checks and duplicate handling, per-run fingerprint, roster and documented language input, and the excluded-file fingerprints
outputs.calls.csv.gz: one row per saved call, modality and direction
outputs.episodes.csv: one row per run, case and recorded episode
outputs.summary.csv: one row per population, case and outcome group
outputs.call_index.csv: first versus later calls per population and case
outputs.provenance.json: protocol, source, input and artifact SHA-256 hashes and the environment

scope_limits: Response-only rescoring of fixed saved rankings on RDT-170M runs with no successes; no ranking efficacy or task-success claim
m=128 IG rankings, a different integration budget from the m=64 PickCube headline cohorts
The historical nominal percentage grid is retained; realized masks are not preserved with these curves
Checkpoint, observation, noise and reference action tensors remain unauthenticated; recorded episodes are not independently randomized units
PickSingleYCB seed-142 language curves were computed with the PickCube instruction embedding as a proxy; they do not describe the PickSingleYCB instruction
